notes: The Receptionist add-on costs $99/mo (lines 699-702). The page gives no included minutes or calls and no overage rates for Receptionist. Receptionist is included in Plus (line 159: "Never miss a lead with an AI-powered Receptionist"). In the comparison table it is marked "Add-on" for the other three plans (lines 472-474). Base plans also come with a 1-year commitment billed monthly (for example, Plus 5 users $439/mo, line 110; Grow 1 user $169/mo, line 171; Connect $119/mo, line 244; Core $39/mo, line 317). Plus comes in 10-user and 15-user tiers ($599/mo and $699/mo with no commitment, lines 121 and 136). Grow and Connect come in 5-, 10- and 15-user tiers. Extra users are $29/mo each (line 103). All prices are in USD and exclude sales tax (line 439). The page lists onboarding "values" (such as the $499 Value for Data Import, line 686), but it does not state any setup fee.

free_trial.text: For 14 days you get full access to all of Jobber’s features on the Grow plan—no credit card required.
